layout_sources: https://github.com/ometa/pnc-to-wave (lib/pnc_to_wave.rb: first row is not transactions; date col 0, amount col 1, description col 2, DEBIT/CREDIT col 5; the amount is negated on DEBIT)

https://github.com/imazen/reunion/blob/master/banks.md (PncStatementActivityCsvParser: statement dates and start/end balances on the first row; date, amount, description, blank, reference, credit/debit)
https://quickbooks.intuit.com/learn-support/en-us/banking/pnc-bank-csv-file-and-debits/00/772257 (the amount column does not mark debits; a separate column says DEBIT or CREDIT)
notes: No header row. The first row is the account: number, period start, period end, beginning balance, ending balance. Then one row per transaction: date, unsigned amount, description, an empty memo, a reference, and DEBIT or CREDIT for the sign. Oldest first. Dates YYYY/MM/DD and CRLF are from memory, not confirmed. Newer PNC online banking may export Date, Description, Withdrawals, Deposits, Balance instead (only converter blogs say so). Opening and closing are on the first row.
